resolved_root_causes: In-transit fleets remained eligible for AI dispatch and replacement orders reset travel progress.
Production could attach to stale in-transit orbit records or create repeated one-ship replacements.
Compatible arriving fleets accumulated as separate records instead of consolidating.
Only one opposing fleet pair per system resolved on a five-tick cadence, while fighter attrition and several fighter-versus-ship mechanics could not close the engagement.
AI production used isolated facilities without checking political control.
Military targeting misapplied a population-loyalty validator and a derived readiness calculation as hard destination gates.
Blockade start removed surface garrisons as if they were troops running the blockade.
TROOPSD.DAT sequential IDs were not normalized to the compound 0x10 family IDs held by seeded regiments.
Repair-start telemetry represented each repair tick instead of entry into a persisted repair episode.
Fleets could not carry surface regiments into hostile systems, so no authoritative landing, ground-invasion, or political-occupation path existed.
The player fleet workflow could not select surface regiments or express transport capacity during a destination order.
root_causes: The current checker equates Imperial political occupation with destruction of the mobile Alliance headquarters.
Death Star fire can bypass Standard leader requirements, while Death Star loss can grant an unsupported immediate Alliance victory.
An uncited 200-tick grace period suppresses otherwise valid victory states.
Occupation deterministically captures every present enemy character without capture/evasion resolution.
AI target selection does not yet acquire every randomized Standard target or exercise the full documented campaign loop.
Alliance production and attack activity collapse across the five-seed campaign probe; this is a faction-liveness failure, not a demand for symmetric attack counts.
Battle volume and geographic spread remain diagnostic only; no located historical source establishes their exact numeric lower bounds.

victory_when_rules_permit.note: No run satisfied Standard HQ-plus-principal-leader capture prerequisites.
